name: new_v2_independent_ring_lag_by_frequency_direction_interaction_v1
hypothesis: Ring-lag envelope coupling and bandwise spectral direction may carry complementary information beyond either single addition to F0v2; evaluate a finite four-arm interaction on native matched ROAM posture, GRAB unseen-user and GRAB cross-day targets.
source_fit: Exactly the parent source subjects/Rest windows, trial splits and classifier hyperparameters for each study; all parent single-arm held-out probabilities must replay within absolute 1e-8.
interaction_metric: For any matched target group, positive loss interaction is log_loss(ring)+log_loss(frequency)-log_loss(joint)-log_loss(F0v2), with corresponding F1 interaction equal F1(joint)-F1(ring)-F1(frequency)+F1(F0v2). Report absolute joint-versus-base benefit separately.
selection: Validation only: require positive interaction and absolute joint improvement in both F1 and log loss on more than one dataset before calling a general combination useful; final scores are descriptive and cannot select.
scope: Finite theory-motivated interaction of independent new-family definitions. These three studies are correlated public evidence, not three independent population replications; no historical formula or own-device claim.
